clinicalPearls: Clozapine is only drug proven in treatment resistance
NMS: fever, rigidity, confusion, high CK; stop antipsychotic
Olanzapine and clozapine worst metabolic; aripiprazole least
reference.pathophysiology: D2 blockade in striatum produces movement disorders while mesolimbic blockade treats psychosis; tuberoinfundibular blockade raises prolactin and hypothalamic actions drive appetite and metabolic syndrome.
additionalDifferentials: NMS versus serotonin syndrome (rigidity bradyreflexia versus clonus hyperreflexia)
Akathisia versus anxiety agitation (inner urge to move)
Tardive dyskinesia versus withdrawal dyskinesia course
additionalInvestigations: Baseline metabolic panel, ECG, prolactin by drug
Clozapine FBC registration, myocarditis vigilance (CRP, troponin local protocol)
